change: the mojibake guard caught the second-order form of the bug and not the bug
_context: smoke/encoding-guard.js gates every pull request and reported this repository
clean while four tracked files were corrupted, including the CED Unit 1 extract
(65 characters) and the hazard note that teaches agents what mojibake looks like.
It reversed through latin-1 only and tried sequence widths 3 and 2 only, so it saw
the DOUBLE corrupted cp1252 form and was blind to the single corrupted form, which
is the one reported on the live page, and blind to every 4 byte character, which is
every emoji. Measured against 12 known cases before the change: 5 caught.
lib/site-crawl.js had independently found and fixed HALF of this (it had cp1252)
and the finding never travelled; it still missed 6 of 16, all of them emoji.

checks.name: the detector is exercised over GENERATED corruption, not pasted strings
the python port and the javascript agree character for character
the live-site crawler still finds mojibake in a rendered body
THE ONE THAT SHIPPED: drop cp1252 and the live-page flavour goes invisible
checks._why: This is the exact state the guard was in before this change. It must go red.
checks.expect_failure: the cp1252 flavour is attributed to cp1252

checks.name: drop latin-1 and the 2026-08-07 incident goes invisible instead
checks._why: Neither codec subsumes the other; each reverses 27 code points the other cannot. Dropping either one goes blind to a whole flavour, so both directions are proved.
checks.expect_failure: the latin-1 flavour is attributed to latin-1

checks.name: THE PROPOSED FIX, PROVED INSUFFICIENT: anchor on U+00C3 alone
checks._why: The obvious general rule is 'an U+00C3 followed by a continuation character'. It is the same inversion one level up: single-pass cp1252 corruption of a bullet is U+00E2 U+20AC U+00A2 and contains no U+00C3 at all. This mutation is that rule, and it must go red, including on the original 2026-08-07 latin-1 incident.
checks.expect_failure: catches single pass latin-1 up triangle (2026-08-07)

checks.name: take away the 4 byte width and every emoji goes invisible
checks._why: The old detector tried widths 3 and 2 only. Every emoji is 4 bytes, and the live page had a corrupted emoji on it.
checks.expect_failure: a 4 byte lead declares width 4, which is every emoji

checks.name: the CRAWLER's mojibake finding is real, not just the repository scan
checks._why: Different suite, different subject: this proves the live-site check fires, which is the one that was supposed to catch the reported page and could not.
checks.expect_failure: a double-encoded EMOJI is detected, which needs a 4 byte sequence width

checks.name: the PYTHON port cannot drift from the javascript unnoticed
checks._why: validate_csv.py gates CED sheets into the live store. Its old pattern list could not match a corrupted emoji at all, and nothing tested it.
checks.expect_failure: every case agrees on index, character, codec and width

checks.name: a second implementation, ICU-derived tables and a byte regex, agrees
checks._why: It disagreed on first run, 25 hits against 65 on the real corrupted CED file, and the rederive was the one that was wrong: TextDecoder('iso-8859-1') is a WHATWG alias for windows-1252, so both its tables were the same codec. That is the class of bug a rederive exists to surface.

checks.name: production serves what this tree is
checks._why: Deferred by --pre. Before the deploy production serves a different commit, so this assertion is false beforehand and true only afterwards.
checks.command: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const want=cp.execSync('git rev-parse HEAD',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().slice(0,7);const got=JSON.parse(cp.execSync('curl -sS --max-time 25 https://progress.apcsexamprep.com/api/health',{encoding:'utf8'})).commit;if(got!==want)throw new Error('production serves '+got+', this tree is '+want);console.log('PRODUCTION SERVES THIS TREE '+got);"
